weapon.name: Bankshot Driver
weapon.description: 900 total travel; up to 2 field-boundary bounces re-arm 1 + pierce hits per leg (max 6). Spent shots coast dim. Position near field edges; no interior-wall bounces.

item.name: Bounce Guide
item.description: Requires Bankshot Driver. First field-boundary bounce aims once at the nearest eligible living target within remaining travel; otherwise reflects normally. No extra damage or range.
item.cost: 1 module slot; direction only, not homing; opportunity is spent even without a target
item.stack_rule: Unique: maximum 1; possession is snapshotted at launch

pair.name: BANKED VECTOR
pair.description: First Bankshot reflection redirects once toward an eligible target. Field-edge positioning matters; the 900 total path never resets.
